integrity: The result is derived from the published CDF, survival, and density. Tail asymptotics give two-sided eventual comparison, which proves the moment and MGF domains; numerical replay is only a consistency check. The official publisher PDF date, 27 March 2026, is used because a secondary index reports an internally inconsistent earlier date preceding its own acceptance date.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies positive raw moments and real exponential transforms, not negative moments or complex transforms.
Analytic continuation of the source incomplete-beta expression outside the convergent region is not a probabilistic moment.
The result corrects domains of mathematical properties and does not by itself invalidate likelihood-based estimation.
title: The APIILx power parameter preserves the Lomax tail index
